What if you never washed your reusable water bottle?
Reusable bottles are great for the planet and save money too. It's just water, right? Many people just refill it again and again for weeks.

But here's the twist. Your mouth adds bacteria with every sip, and some lab tests found millions of germs on bottles that weren't washed. Wash it every day! Use hot soapy water and a bottle brush, and let it dry fully. Narrow necks and straw lids are the hardest spots to clean, so give them extra attention.
